name: nvgGlobalCompositeOperation
doc: The composite operations in NanoVG are modeled after HTML Canvas API, and the blend func is based on OpenGL (see corresponding manuals for more info). The colors in the blending state have premultiplied alpha. Sets the composite operation. The op parameter should be one of NVGcompositeOperation.

name: nvgGlobalCompositeBlendFunc
signature: void nvgGlobalCompositeBlendFunc(NVGcontext* ctx, int sfactor, int dfactor)
doc: Sets the composite operation with custom pixel arithmetic. The parameters should be one of NVGblendFactor.

name: nvgGlobalCompositeBlendFuncSeparate
signature: void nvgGlobalCompositeBlendFuncSeparate(NVGcontext* ctx, int srcRGB, int dstRGB, int srcAlpha, int dstAlpha)
doc: Sets the composite operation with custom pixel arithmetic for RGB and alpha components separately. The parameters should be one of NVGblendFactor.

name: nvgRGB
signature: NVGcolor nvgRGB(unsigned char r, unsigned char g, unsigned char b)
doc: Colors in NanoVG are stored as unsigned ints in ABGR format. Returns a color value from red, green, blue values. Alpha will be set to 255 (1.0f).

name: nvgRGBf
signature: NVGcolor nvgRGBf(float r, float g, float b)
doc: Returns a color value from red, green, blue values. Alpha will be set to 1.0f.

name: nvgRGBA
signature: NVGcolor nvgRGBA(unsigned char r, unsigned char g, unsigned char b, unsigned char a)
doc: Returns a color value from red, green, blue and alpha values.

name: nvgRGBAf
signature: NVGcolor nvgRGBAf(float r, float g, float b, float a)
doc: Returns a color value from red, green, blue and alpha values.

name: nvgLerpRGBA
signature: NVGcolor nvgLerpRGBA(NVGcolor c0, NVGcolor c1, float u)
doc: Linearly interpolates from color c0 to c1, and returns resulting color value.

name: nvgTransRGBA
signature: NVGcolor nvgTransRGBA(NVGcolor c0, unsigned char a)
doc: Sets transparency of a color value.

name: nvgTransRGBAf
doc: Sets transparency of a color value.

name: nvgHSL
signature: NVGcolor nvgHSL(float h, float s, float l)
doc: Returns color value specified by hue, saturation and lightness. HSL values are all in range [0..1], alpha will be set to 255.

name: nvgHSLA
signature: NVGcolor nvgHSLA(float h, float s, float l, unsigned char a)
doc: Returns color value specified by hue, saturation and lightness and alpha. HSL values are all in range [0..1], alpha in range [0..255]

name: nvgSave
doc: NanoVG contains state which represents how paths will be rendered. The state contains transform, fill and stroke styles, text and font styles, and scissor clipping. Pushes and saves the current render state into a state stack. A matching nvgRestore() must be used to restore the state.

name: nvgRestore
doc: Pops and restores current render state.

name: nvgReset
doc: Resets current render state to default values. Does not affect the render state stack.

name: nvgShapeAntiAlias
doc: Fill and stroke render style can be either a solid color or a paint which is a gradient or a pattern. Solid color is simply defined as a color value, different kinds of paints can be created using nvgLinearGradient(), nvgBoxGradient(), nvgRadialGradient() and nvgImagePattern(). Current render style can be saved and restored using nvgSave() and nvgRestore(). Sets whether to draw antialias for nvgStroke() and nvgFill(). It's enabled by default.

name: nvgStrokeColor
doc: Sets current stroke style to a solid color.

name: nvgStrokePaint
doc: Sets current stroke style to a paint, which can be a one of the gradients or a pattern.

name: nvgFillColor
doc: Sets current fill style to a solid color.

name: nvgFillPaint
doc: Sets current fill style to a paint, which can be a one of the gradients or a pattern.

name: nvgMiterLimit
doc: Sets the miter limit of the stroke style. Miter limit controls when a sharp corner is beveled.

name: nvgStrokeWidth
doc: Sets the stroke width of the stroke style.

name: nvgLineCap
doc: Sets how the end of the line (cap) is drawn, Can be one of: NVG_BUTT (default), NVG_ROUND, NVG_SQUARE.

name: nvgLineJoin
doc: Sets how sharp path corners are drawn. Can be one of NVG_MITER (default), NVG_ROUND, NVG_BEVEL.

name: nvgGlobalAlpha
doc: Sets the transparency applied to all rendered shapes. Already transparent paths will get proportionally more transparent as well.

name: nvgResetTransform
doc: The paths, gradients, patterns and scissor region are transformed by an transformation matrix at the time when they are passed to the API. The current transformation matrix is a affine matrix: [sx kx tx] [ky sy ty] [ 0  0  1] Where: sx,sy define scaling, kx,ky skewing, and tx,ty translation. The last row is assumed to be 0,0,1 and is not stored. Apart from nvgResetTransform(), each transformation function first creates specific transformation matrix and pre-multiplies the current transformation by it. Current coordinate system (transformation) can be saved and restored using nvgSave() and nvgRestore(). Resets current transform to a identity matrix.

name: nvgTransform
signature: void nvgTransform(NVGcontext* ctx, float a, float b, float c, float d, float e, float f)
doc: Premultiplies current coordinate system by specified matrix. The parameters are interpreted as matrix as follows: [a c e] [b d f] [0 0 1]

name: nvgTranslate
signature: void nvgTranslate(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y)
doc: Translates current coordinate system.

name: nvgRotate
doc: Rotates current coordinate system. Angle is specified in radians.

name: nvgSkewX
doc: Skews the current coordinate system along X axis. Angle is specified in radians.

name: nvgSkewY
doc: Skews the current coordinate system along Y axis. Angle is specified in radians.

name: nvgScale
signature: void nvgScale(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y)
doc: Scales the current coordinate system.

name: nvgDegToRad
doc: Converts degrees to radians and vice versa.

name: nvgDeleteImage
doc: Deletes created image.

name: nvgLinearGradient
signature: NVGpaint nvgLinearGradient(NVGcontext* ctx, float sx, float sy, float ex, float ey, NVGcolor icol, NVGcolor ocol)
doc: NanoVG supports four types of paints: linear gradient, box gradient, radial gradient and image pattern. These can be used as paints for strokes and fills. Creates and returns a linear gradient. Parameters (sx,sy)-(ex,ey) specify the start and end coordinates of the linear gradient, icol specifies the start color and ocol the end color. The gradient is transformed by the current transform when it is passed to nvgFillPaint() or nvgStrokePaint().

name: nvgBoxGradient
signature: NVGpaint nvgBoxGradient(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r, float f, NVGcolor icol, NVGcolor ocol)
doc: Creates and returns a box gradient. Box gradient is a feathered rounded rectangle, it is useful for rendering drop shadows or highlights for boxes. Parameters (x,y) define the top-left corner of the rectangle, (w,h) define the size of the rectangle, r defines the corner radius, and f feather. Feather defines how blurry the border of the rectangle is. Parameter icol specifies the inner color and ocol the outer color of the gradient. The gradient is transformed by the current transform when it is passed to nvgFillPaint() or nvgStrokePaint().

name: nvgRadialGradient
signature: NVGpaint nvgRadialGradient(NVGcontext* ctx, float cx, float cy, float inr, float outr, NVGcolor icol, NVGcolor ocol)
doc: Creates and returns a radial gradient. Parameters (cx,cy) specify the center, inr and outr specify the inner and outer radius of the gradient, icol specifies the start color and ocol the end color. The gradient is transformed by the current transform when it is passed to nvgFillPaint() or nvgStrokePaint().

name: nvgImagePattern
signature: NVGpaint nvgImagePattern(NVGcontext* ctx, float ox, float oy, float ex, float ey, float angle, int image, float alpha)
doc: Creates and returns an image pattern. Parameters (ox,oy) specify the left-top location of the image pattern, (ex,ey) the size of one image, angle rotation around the top-left corner, image is handle to the image to render. The gradient is transformed by the current transform when it is passed to nvgFillPaint() or nvgStrokePaint().

name: nvgScissor
signature: void nvgScissor(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float w, float h)
doc: Scissoring allows you to clip the rendering into a rectangle. This is useful for various user interface cases like rendering a text edit or a timeline. Sets the current scissor rectangle. The scissor rectangle is transformed by the current transform.

name: nvgIntersectScissor
signature: void nvgIntersectScissor(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float w, float h)
doc: Intersects current scissor rectangle with the specified rectangle. The scissor rectangle is transformed by the current transform. Note: in case the rotation of previous scissor rect differs from the current one, the intersection will be done between the specified rectangle and the previous scissor rectangle transformed in the current transform space. The resulting shape is always rectangle.

name: nvgResetScissor
doc: Reset and disables scissoring.

name: nvgBeginPath
doc: Drawing a new shape starts with nvgBeginPath(), it clears all the currently defined paths. Then you define one or more paths and sub-paths which describe the shape. The are functions to draw common shapes like rectangles and circles, and lower level step-by-step functions, which allow to define a path curve by curve. NanoVG uses even-odd fill rule to draw the shapes. Solid shapes should have counter clockwise winding and holes should have counter clockwise order. To specify winding of a path you can call nvgPathWinding(). This is useful especially for the common shapes, which are drawn CCW. Finally you can fill the path using current fill style by calling nvgFill(), and stroke it with current stroke style by calling nvgStroke(). The curve segments and sub-paths are transformed by the current transform. Clears the current path and sub-paths.

name: nvgMoveTo
signature: void nvgMoveTo(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y)
doc: Starts new sub-path with specified point as first point.

name: nvgLineTo
signature: void nvgLineTo(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y)
doc: Adds line segment from the last point in the path to the specified point.

name: nvgBezierTo
signature: void nvgBezierTo(NVGcontext* ctx, float c1x, float c1y, float c2x, float c2y, float x, float y)
doc: Adds cubic bezier segment from last point in the path via two control points to the specified point.

name: nvgQuadTo
signature: void nvgQuadTo(NVGcontext* ctx, float cx, float cy, float x, float y)
doc: Adds quadratic bezier segment from last point in the path via a control point to the specified point.

name: nvgArcTo
signature: void nvgArcTo(NVGcontext* ctx, float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float radius)
doc: Adds an arc segment at the corner defined by the last path point, and two specified points.

name: nvgClosePath
doc: Closes current sub-path with a line segment.

name: nvgPathWinding
doc: Sets the current sub-path winding, see NVGwinding and NVGsolidity.

name: nvgArc
signature: void nvgArc(NVGcontext* ctx, float cx, float cy, float r, float a0, float a1, int dir)
doc: Creates new circle arc shaped sub-path. The arc center is at cx,cy, the arc radius is r, and the arc is drawn from angle a0 to a1, and swept in direction dir (NVG_CCW, or NVG_CW). Angles are specified in radians.

name: nvgRect
signature: void nvgRect(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float w, float h)
doc: Creates new rectangle shaped sub-path.

name: nvgRoundedRect
signature: void nvgRoundedRect(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float w, float h, float r)
doc: Creates new rounded rectangle shaped sub-path.

name: nvgRoundedRectVarying
signature: void nvgRoundedRectVarying(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float w, float h, float radTopLeft, float radTopRight, float radBottomRight, float radBottomLeft)
doc: Creates new rounded rectangle shaped sub-path with varying radii for each corner.

name: nvgEllipse
signature: void nvgEllipse(NVGcontext* ctx, float cx, float cy, float rx, float ry)
doc: Creates new ellipse shaped sub-path.

name: nvgCircle
signature: void nvgCircle(NVGcontext* ctx, float cx, float cy, float r)
doc: Creates new circle shaped sub-path.

name: nvgFill
doc: Fills the current path with current fill style.

name: nvgStroke
doc: Fills the current path with current stroke style.

name: nvgFindFont
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: int nvgFindFont(NVGcontext* ctx, const char* name)
doc: Finds a loaded font of specified name, and returns handle to it, or -1 if the font is not found.

name: nvgAddFallbackFontId
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: int nvgAddFallbackFontId(NVGcontext* ctx, int baseFont, int fallbackFont)
doc: Adds a fallback font by handle.

name: nvgAddFallbackFont
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: int nvgAddFallbackFont(NVGcontext* ctx, const char* baseFont, const char* fallbackFont)
doc: Adds a fallback font by name.

name: nvgResetFallbackFontsId
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Resets fallback fonts by handle.

name: nvgResetFallbackFonts
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: void nvgResetFallbackFonts(NVGcontext* ctx, const char* baseFont)
doc: Resets fallback fonts by name.

name: nvgFontSize
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the font size of current text style.

name: nvgFontBlur
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the blur of current text style.

name: nvgFontDilate
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the dilation of current text style.

name: nvgTextLetterSpacing
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the letter spacing of current text style.

name: nvgTextLineHeight
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the proportional line height of current text style. The line height is specified as multiple of font size.

name: nvgTextAlign
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the text align of current text style, see NVGalign for options.

name: nvgFontFaceId
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Sets the font face based on specified id of current text style.

name: nvgFontFace
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: void nvgFontFace(NVGcontext* ctx, const char* font)
doc: Sets the font face based on specified name of current text style.

name: nvgText
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: float nvgText(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, const char* string, const char* end)
doc: Draws text string at specified location. If end is specified only the sub-string up to the end is drawn.

name: nvgTextBox
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
signature: void nvgTextBox(NVGcontext* ctx, float x, float y, float breakRowWidth, const char* string, const char* end)
doc: Draws multi-line text string at specified location wrapped at the specified width. If end is specified only the sub-string up to the end is drawn. The text is split at word boundaries or when new-line characters are encountered. Words longer than the max width are slit at nearest character (i.e. no hyphenation).

name: nvgFontQuality
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.

name: nvgStencil
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Work like nvgFill, but only supports drawing image with alpha channels. The image is used to create a stencil buffer, which will be used for subsequent drawing operations, and only the content corresponding to the non-transparent part of the stencil buffer will be displayed.

name: nvgStencilClear
section: At render time the font face can be set based on the font handles or name.
doc: Clear stencil buffer and disable stencil test.
